name: Hey, Moon Eyes
source:
'Hey, Moon Eyes!' Is a visual novel about learning to cherish every precious moment before it passes.

Follow the story of Revri and Duncan from their first meeting at the outset of an impossible, one-way journey, to its inevitable end.

What they find will be everything they could have imagined and more.  Alien wonders, and terrors, a world, a life, all theirs to build. But what of the costs?

If only they could have known, if only they had acted differently. All of this could have been avoided...

But, then, they would do it all again anyway.

[From [url=https://neiffarious.itch.io/hey-moon-eyes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“嘿，月眼！”是一部关于学会珍惜每一个珍贵时刻的视觉小说。

跟随Revri和Duncan的故事，从他们第一次见面、一段不可能的单程旅程开始，一直到不可避免的结局。

他们所发现的将是他们能想象到的一切，甚至更多。外星奇观、恐怖、世界、生命，全由他们来建造。但费用又如何呢？

如果他们能够知道，如果他们采取不同的行动就好了。这一切本来是可以避免的……

但无论如何，他们还是会重蹈覆辙。

[来自[url=https://neiffarious.itch.io/hey-moon-eyes]Itch.io[/url]]
